entries.text: Generally had a single horn — Ps 92:10.
Sometimes found with two horns — De 33:17.
The young of, remarkable for agility — Ps 29:6.
Of God as the strength of Israel. — Nu 23:22; 24:8.
(Horns of,) of the strength of the descendants of Joseph. — De 33:17.
(Horns of,) of the strength of powerful enemies. — Ps 22:21.
(The position of its horns,) of the exaltation of saints. — Ps 92:10.
